instructions: Return only final JSON matching the response schema. Tools are forbidden. Do not use files, shell, network, or external services. Do not include chain-of-thought or reasoning steps.
prompt:
Improve HGB descriptors from current validation feedback/summaries and the TRAIN/validation memory below. Return JSON {features,queries,rationale,notes}: new complete1..20 {name,description,source}, not a patch; rationale<=200 Unicode chars; notes<=300 Unicode chars, one concise scientific note, no reasoning steps. Initial []=Magpie-only. Current set=previous model's retained inner-fit features (>20% failures dropped); original code is complete, never budget-truncated. No external held-out feedback.
Per source: only def feature(s), one numeric scalar; no helpers/decorators/annotations/outer code. Distinct descriptors, no predictors/material lookups; handle empty/None.
Readonly original-H3 s:
lattice={matrix:3x3 Angstrom row vectors,lengths_A:[a,b,c],angles_deg:[alpha,beta,gamma],a_A,b_A,c_A,alpha_deg,beta_deg,gamma_deg,volume_A3}.
sites=[{element:str,frac_coords:3 floats in[0,1),occupancy:float}].
neighbors=[{i:int,j:int,image:3 ints,distance_A:float}]: all directed periodic6-A neighbors; image translates j; no zero-image self/truncation.
composition={element:atomic_fraction}; n_sites,n_elements:int; volume_per_atom_A3,density_g_cm3:float.
element_properties={element:{Z,group,row,eneg,covalent_radius_A,mass_amu,valence_electrons,pymatgen_valence_subshell,first_ionization_energy_eV,electron_affinity_eV,melting_point_K,boiling_point_K,atomic_radius_A,missing_fields}}. Missing numbers=None; valence:H3 convention (not oxidation); subshell:(l,occupancy) or None. Atomic energies allowed; target/IDs/split absent.
basic_structure_statistics={volume_per_atom_A3,density_g_cm3,min_neighbor_distance_6A_A,mean_neighbor_distance_6A_A,std_neighbor_distance_6A_A,mean_coordination_6A,std_coordination_6A,lattice_anisotropy,max_angle_deviation_from90_deg}. std:ddof0; coordination:images included; empty distances:0; anisotropy:max(a,b,c)/min(a,b,c).
Local variables/if/loops/comprehensions/list/tuple/dict allowed. No import,I/O,network,reflection,private/dunder attrs,eval/exec,dynamic calls,recursion,random,input mutation,object dtype. Limits:function20000chars/2500ASTnodes;50ms/structure. AST/runtime/timeout failure=>NaN. Drop only at>20% inner-fit TRAIN failures, never validation/TEST failures.
Only these preprovided names/operations: builtins:abs,all,any,bool,enumerate,float,int,len,list,max,min,range,round,sorted,sum,tuple,zip; math:acos,asin,atan,atan2,ceil,copysign,cos,cosh,degrees,e,exp,expm1,fabs,floor,fsum,hypot,inf,isfinite,isinf,isnan,log,log10,log1p,log2,nan,pi,prod,radians,sin,sinh,sqrt,tan,tanh,tau; np:abs,absolute,all,amax,amin,any,arange,arccos,arcsin,arctan,arctan2,argsort,array,asarray,average,clip,concatenate,cos,cosh,count_nonzero,cross,diag,diagonal,diff,dot,e,exp,expm1,eye,full,hstack,inf,isfinite,isinf,isnan,linspace,log,log10,log1p,log2,matmul,max,maximum,mean,median,min,minimum,nan,nanmax,nanmean,nanmedian,nanmin,nanstd,nansum,ones,percentile,pi,power,ptp,quantile,ravel,reshape,sin,sinh,sort,sqrt,square,stack,std,sum,tan,tanh,trace,transpose,unique,var,vstack,where,zeros; np.linalg:det,eigvals,eigvalsh,matrix_rank,norm,svd; data attrs:T,ndim,shape,size; data methods:get,items,keys,max,mean,min,ravel,reshape,std,sum,transpose,values,var
queries:0..3 ordered; each n>=1 integer, sum<=75. Optional unique POOL symbols:include_all=all,include_any=one if nonempty,exclude=none. n_elements,n_sites:closed positive[lo,hi]; template_spacegroup:closed1..230 from POOL final_structure. Conditions AND; unlabeled-only. Fixed arm/seed/round/query RNG draws min(n,matches), no repeats across queries. All unused quota carries, no round topup. After20 uniformly fill budget to2000, no extra feature/notes update. Invalid query:one correction then[] if invalid; root:features,queries,rationale<=200 Unicode chars,notes<=300 Unicode chars.
